title: Sea-King's Blessing — Dominion of the Deep
revision: Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Water classification / forked tree

classification.selector: jutsu classification: the qualifying element(s), whatever the jutsu's source
classification.applies_to: matching supported tags on all Water jutsu
not_selectors: equipment / required bloodline item (castability gate only)
classification.off_kit_coverage: unverified (no non-bloodline jutsu catalog with effect rows in the repository)

emphasis.primary: Increase Damage Taken — Crushing Abyss's broad circle exposure and Water Dome's Water-only exposure (two rows, +8% route, ×1.124)
emphasis.secondary: Water Damage — Sea King's Armor and Crushing Abyss (two 38 EP formula rows, +2 steady-edge route)
emphasis.tertiary: Decrease Damage Taken — Sea King's Armor's self reduction (one row, +10% route)
emphasis.rationale: Sea-King's Blessing is a rank-C kit whose five supported rows split 2/2/1: two 38 EP Water hits (Sea King's Armor, Crushing Abyss; 60 AP, cooldown 7), two enemy Increase Damage Taken rows (Abyss 30% on enemies in its circle, all four stat types and no element; Water Dome 35% Water-only on a 40 AP, cooldown-6 cast) and one 30% self Decrease Damage Taken row on Armor. Exposure is primary: one cast amplifies every matching hit the target takes for two rounds, allies' included, and the two rows compound on Water hits, so the route stops at +8% (×1.124 with both windows live, against Blood-Enchanted Eyes' ×1.115 exposure maximum). Scales of the Deep answers "How do I win the exchange myself: hit harder, or take less?" (Steady edge, Fortress); Salt in the Wound answers "How do I make them take more from everyone?" (Exposure). Each Advanced Art carries one tag; the only flat Damage is the steady-edge route's +2 (Grip of the Riptide's +1 commit, Weight of the Trench +1), which takes both hits from Light to Normal (38 → 40). Potency reaches matching supported tags on all Water jutsu (RUL-2026-10-03-005). Absorb and shield rows are unsupported.

nodes.name: Scales of the Deep
nodes.flavor: The sea-king's gift settles on the skin first: salt-hard scale over everything it guards.
nodes.coverage_note: Armor's self Decrease Damage Taken 30 → 32% (2 rounds, all four stat types, no element). Opens the steady edge and Fortress.

nodes.name: Grip of the Riptide
nodes.flavor: What the riptide takes, it takes whole. There is no half-drowning.
nodes.coverage_note: Both Water hits, Sea King's Armor and Crushing Abyss, 38 → 39 EP; still in the Light tier.

nodes.name: Weight of the Trench
nodes.flavor: Miles of black water press down at once, and nothing built by hands keeps its shape.
nodes.coverage_note: Steady edge: Armor and Abyss 38 → 40 EP on the full route (+2 Damage), Light → Normal; the bloodline's Water IDG passive multiplies on top.

nodes.name: Deepwater Carapace
nodes.flavor: Pressure that would crush a hull only sets the sea-king's armor tighter.
nodes.coverage_note: Armor's Decrease Damage Taken 32 → 35% with Scales of the Deep (self, 2 rounds per 60 AP cast, cooldown 7).

nodes.name: Hull of the Leviathan
nodes.flavor: No storm has ever opened the leviathan. The sea-king wears its hide and dares the storm.
nodes.coverage_note: Fortress: Armor's reduction 30 → 40% on the full route (+10%) for the 2 rounds after each cast; pierce bypasses it.

nodes.name: Salt in the Wound
nodes.flavor: Brine finds every cut. After the sea-king marks you, so does everything else.
nodes.coverage_note: Abyss exposure 30 → 32% (enemies in the circle, all stat types, no element); Dome exposure 35 → 37% (Water hits only).

nodes.name: Dragged Under
nodes.flavor: Once the current has your ankle, every blow lands on someone who cannot stand.
nodes.coverage_note: Abyss exposure 32 → 34%, Dome 37 → 39% with Salt in the Wound (enemy debuffs, 2 rounds).

nodes.name: Wrath of the Sea-King
nodes.flavor: The deep has a king, and the king has run out of mercy.
nodes.coverage_note: Exposure: Abyss 30 → 38% and Dome 35 → 43% on the full route (+8%), ×1.124 with both live (Blood-Enchanted Eyes' maximum ×1.115); a Water hit under both takes ×1.38 × 1.43 ≈ ×1.97 (×1.755 at base).

examples.name: Weight of the Trench
examples.rationale: +2 Damage on both Water hits: Armor and Abyss 38 → 40 EP (Light → Normal), before the Water IDG passive. Salt in the Wound is the offensive fourth purchase (Abyss 32%, Dome 37%). With Dome a round before Abyss, then Armor, the two hits total 40 × 1.37 + 40 × 1.32 × 1.37 ≈ 127 raw EP (base ≈ 118, Exposure ≈ 129); with Abyss and Dome in one round Abyss's hit is unexposed and steady edge ≈ 112, base ≈ 105, Exposure ≈ 113. The steady edge's case is uptime: the +2 lands on every Water hit, off-kit and outside the exposure windows included. Deepwater Carapace (Armor 35%) is the trading alternative.

examples.name: Hull of the Leviathan
examples.rationale: Armor's Decrease Damage Taken 30 → 40% (+10%) for its two rounds against effectively every non-pierce hit; no flat Damage. Salt in the Wound adds 32%/37% exposure so the fortress still marks targets for the team; Grip of the Riptide (hits 39/39 EP) is the offensive alternative.

examples.name: Wrath of the Sea-King
examples.rationale: +8% on both exposure rows: Abyss 38% (enemies in the circle, all stat types, no element), Dome 43% (Water hits only, 40 AP, cooldown 6). A Water hit under both takes ×1.38 × 1.43 ≈ ×1.97 (×1.755 at base; ×1.124 from the tree): the caster's Armor hit after Abyss and Dome, and allies' Water jutsu. A row never covers its own jutsu's hit and Abyss's cooldown 7 outlasts its window, so Abyss's own hit gets at most Dome's ×1.43. Solo, Dome then Abyss then Armor totals 38 × 1.43 + 38 × 1.38 × 1.43 ≈ 129 raw EP (≈ 113 with Abyss and Dome in one round), level with or slightly ahead of the steady edge's ≈ 127 (≈ 112). Every ally's hit on the marked target gains too, and Abyss's element-less row also lifts the caster's own non-Water hits (×1.38). Scales of the Deep is the only legal fourth purchase (Armor 32%).

narrow_kit_exception: Eight nodes and three Advanced Arts rather than ten and four, as in the pre-batch tree. The kit has three supported tags on five rows (Damage x2, Increase Damage Taken x2, Decrease Damage Taken x1), one route each: Scales of the Deep forks into Steady edge (Grip of the Riptide → Weight of the Trench) and Fortress (Deepwater Carapace → Hull of the Leviathan); Salt in the Wound → Dragged Under → Wrath of the Sea-King is the single exposure chain. A fourth route needs a fourth tag (absorb and shield are not potency targets). Universal node accepted: Scales of the Deep is in all 8 legal full builds, so Exposure's fourth purchase is always its +2% Decrease Damage Taken. A 1 BP leaf under Salt in the Wound would end that, but each option fails: Increase Damage Taken twins Dragged Under and hands Exposure's fourth its own tag again (back toward the +10% the route was cut from), Damage puts flat Damage on the exposure capstone's build, and Decrease Damage Taken is an off-axis twin of Scales of the Deep (or dominates or is dominated by it).
design_notes: Node split: 2 Foundations, 3 Hidden Arts, 3 Advanced Arts. Scales of the Deep (+2% Decrease Damage Taken) is the self-side root: Grip of the Riptide (+1 Damage) → Weight of the Trench (+1 Damage) and Deepwater Carapace (+3%) → Hull of the Leviathan (+5% Decrease Damage Taken). Salt in the Wound → Dragged Under → Wrath of the Sea-King (+2%/+2%/+4% Increase Damage Taken) is the enemy-side chain. Any two Advanced Arts cost 5 or 6 BP.

2026-10-04 rebalance: the flat-Damage route goes from +5 to +2 Damage (38 → 40, Light → Normal, instead of 43), the roster default for kits whose only hits are 38 EP Light rows; +3 (38 → 41) was the first-pass value. With no percentage setup it is a steady edge (+1 commit, then +1), not burst. Grip of the Riptide keeps a +1 commit because the kit's only other tags each own a Hidden Art on the same rows: a percentage setup there would twin Dragged Under or Deepwater Carapace. The +1 leaves both hits Light (39) and Weight of the Trench's +1 makes the Normal step. Exposure goes +10% → +8% (Dragged Under +3% → +2%, Wrath of the Sea-King +5% → +4%): two team-wide rows that compound on Water hits sit at the roster's two-row cap (×1.124 with both live, against Blood-Enchanted Eyes' ×1.115 and Shakunetsu Sakura's ×1.075), and the capstone still pays more than its Hidden Art. The +1 Damage riders on Hull of the Leviathan and Wrath of the Sea-King are removed as filler. Maxima over every legal allocation: +2 Damage, +8% Increase Damage Taken, +10% Decrease Damage Taken.

Wiring kept after review: an offense/defense split (Salt in the Wound parenting Exposure and the steady edge, Scales of the Deep → Fortress alone) was rejected because Exposure's obvious fourth becomes the steady edge's Hidden Art. With Grip as flat Damage, Exposure gains raw Damage and still out-amplifies the team; with Grip as an exposure setup the pair stacks the route's own tag. Under the self/enemy split, the exposure capstone's only fourth is a +2% Decrease Damage Taken.

Interactions: Armor's DDT row and Abyss's IDT row list all four stat types with no element, so they match effectively every hit; Dome's IDT row lists Water only. Each IDT row multiplies a matching hit by 1 + p/100 and two live rows compound (§3b); the bloodline's Water IDG passive (15 + 0.15/level) multiplies the two Water hits last. Rows are live the two rounds after the cast round, never on their own jutsu's hit.

Delivery: all three jutsu are OTHER_USER at range 4. Armor (60 AP, cooldown 7, SINGLE) hits and gives the caster DDT 30% plus an unsupported 100 shield. Abyss (60 AP, cooldown 7, radius-1 AOE_CIRCLE_SPAWN) hits and exposes enemies in the circle (friendly fire ENEMIES; never the caster). Dome (40 AP, cooldown 6, SINGLE) exposes the target. Aimed at an ally, ENEMIES rows are withheld; SELF rows still land.

Fourth purchases: Steady edge (01,02,03) takes Salt in the Wound (32%/37% exposure) or Deepwater Carapace (Armor 35%); Fortress (01,04,05) takes Salt in the Wound or Grip of the Riptide (39/39 EP); Exposure (01,06,07,08) only Scales of the Deep. Raw EP × exposure for the caster's two kit hits, Dome then Abyss then Armor: base ≈ 118, steady edge + Salt ≈ 127 (40 × 1.37 + 40 × 1.32 × 1.37), Exposure ≈ 129 (38 × 1.43 + 38 × 1.38 × 1.43); with Abyss and Dome in one round Abyss's hit is unexposed and base ≈ 105, steady edge + Salt ≈ 112, Exposure ≈ 113. Exposure leads with allies on the marked target and on the caster's non-Water hits in Abyss's window (×1.38 against ×1.32); the steady edge's +2 lands on every Water hit, off-kit and outside the windows included. The no-capstone hybrid 01,02,06,07 (39/39 EP, 34%/39%) totals ≈ 127 (Dome first) or ≈ 112 (same round): it trades the steady edge's second Damage point for +2% more exposure, a margin choice rather than a dominant one.
risks: Classification: Water is shared with many other bloodlines (expected under RUL-2026-10-03-005). 3 of 5 kit rows carry Water; Armor's DDT and Abyss's IDT rows have no element and sit on Water jutsu, so they need the proposed jutsu-classification resolver. Off-kit Water coverage is unverified.

Exposure is the highest-leverage route: Abyss's 38% reaches effectively every hit any ally lands on each enemy in the circle, and with Dome's 43% Water hits take ×1.97 (×1.755 at base): ×1.124 from the tree, above Blood-Enchanted Eyes' ×1.115 exposure maximum and Shakunetsu Sakura's ×1.075. It is level with or slightly ahead of the steady edge on the caster's own rotation and stronger in group fights; no simulation was run.

Off-kit flat Damage: +2 reaches every Water damage row the caster uses. The kit's two rows end at 40, but an off-kit 45 or 50 EP Water row would become 47 or 52 (the Arashima and Blood-Enchanted Eyes precedent levels); that catalog is unverified.
Universal opener (accepted; narrow_kit_exception has the leaf enumeration): an Exposure player always buys Scales of the Deep's +2% Decrease Damage Taken.

DDT breadth: Armor's reduction applies to effectively every non-pierce hit, so +10% makes it 40% for the two rounds after each cast (two in seven); pierce bypasses it. The bloodline's Earth IDT 10% passive stays. Armor's shield and Dome's absorb are unsupported and unchanged.

Damage is formula-calculated (sqrt stat scaling) and then multiplied by the Water IDG passive and any exposure on the target, so +2 raw EP is not linear +2 damage; the rotation figures in the design notes are raw EP × exposure only.
Ranked modes: skill-tree effects are skipped in RANKED_PVP and RANKED_SPARRING at the pin, so no node applies there.

audit.revision: Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Water classification / forked tree
limits: Proposed element-wide potency classification; not implemented or verified in the live engine (needs a jutsu-classification resolver).

Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Water jutsu. Off-kit jutsu of the element are in scope by rule; their count is unverified. Original combat elements, recipients and stat/general/element filters stay intact.
Bloodline id, equipment, injected-child provenance and jutsu names are not selectors; equipment only gates castability.
Coverage counts below are this kit's rows only. Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.
Damage values are raw power (EP), not final-damage percentages; every other modifier is shown with %. Percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.

Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.
Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.
No combat simulation. Budget and numerical non-dominance checks do not establish equal combat strength.
Main-tree effects, bloodline passives, equipment, AP, uptime and modifier delivery are outside this audit.

foundation_sentences.01: How do I win the exchange myself: hit harder, or take less?
foundation_sentences.06: How do I make them take more from everyone?

route_identities.03: steady edge: a +1 commit, then +1 Damage on both Water hits (38 → 40), every cast, no setup window
route_identities.05: fortress: Armor's window takes less from nearly every hit
route_identities.08: exposure: team-wide amplification on marked targets (×1.124)

design_review.director_review: Roster questions: DQ-B (Wrath of the Sea-King +8% Increase Damage Taken on two compounding rows, Abyss 30 → 38% and Dome 35 → 43%, ×1.124 against Blood-Enchanted Eyes' ×1.115 and Shakunetsu Sakura's ×1.075); DQ-D (Grip of the Riptide +1 Damage, the commit of a 1/1 steady-edge route, 38 → 39 → 40: a percentage setup there would twin Dragged Under or Deepwater Carapace).
concerns: Exposure at +8% on two compounding, team-wide rows (×1.124 from the tree; ×1.38 × 1.43 ≈ ×1.97 on Water hits under both, ×1.755 at base) is level with or slightly ahead of the steady edge on the caster's own kit hits (≈ 129 against ≈ 127 raw EP, Dome first) and leads in groups; not simulated.

The steady edge is the smallest route on paper (+2 Damage, 40/38 ≈ ×1.05 on a kit hit): its case is uptime, since the +2 lands on every Water hit with no setup. The no-capstone hybrid 01,02,06,07 reaches about the same solo rotation by trading one Damage for +2% exposure.
Grip of the Riptide keeps a +1 Damage commit on a Hidden Art: a percentage setup there would twin Dragged Under or Deepwater Carapace, and the +1 keeps both hits Light (39).
Scales of the Deep stays a universal node: Exposure's fourth purchase is forced to +2% Decrease Damage Taken.
Off-kit Water damage rows reached by +2 are unverified (an off-kit 50 EP Water row would read 52).
